Functions and constants. Separate arguments with \";\" or a comma followed by a space.
bin, oct and hex show a number in another base, and dec(x, n) reads x in base n.

\"k\" means a thousand and \"kk\" a million. \"thousand\" and \"million\" work too.
Without \"to\" or \"in\", an amount converts to the default currency.
